pull.title: KAFKA-21269: Add tests for describing broker configs with raw string values
pull.body:
## Summary
Cluster-wide broker configs and listener-prefixed broker configs reach
`createBrokerConfigEntry` as raw strings instead of parsed values. For
LIST configs, passing them to `ConfigDef.convertToString` would throw
ClassCastException, so a guard returns them unchanged. No test covered
this guard yet.

This PR adds two tests to `DescribeConfigsTest`:
1.  testDescribeConfigsClusterWideListConfig: sets
`log.cleanup.policy=compact,delete` as a cluster-wide dynamic config and
describes it.
2. testDescribeConfigsPrefixedListenerListConfig:  sets
`listener.name.external.ssl.enabled.protocols` as a static broker config
and describes it.

Reviewers: Murali Basani <muralidhar.basani@aiven.io>

repo.name: kafka
repo.description: Apache Kafka - A distributed event streaming platform

review_comments.body: nit: thinking instead of waitForCondition retrying on any exception, how about waiting only for the source to propagate? A regression would then fail immediately with a clear diff.
Thanks for the suggestion! I agree this would make it fail faster. I adjusted the code.

Did you check that the tests fail when the `case v: String => v` guard is removed from createBrokerConfigEntry?

>Did you check that the tests fail when the case v: String => v guard is removed from createBrokerConfigEntry?

Yes, I removed that fallback and tested locally. The 2 new tests would fail.
